annotations.title: Stateless Consent & One-Click Unsubscribe Tokens API

description: Stateless Consent & One-Click Unsubscribe Tokens API: Issue and verify stateless HMAC unsubscribe tokens and RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers. (Endpoint: POST /v1/consent-tokens/issue)

purpose.description: Optional granular consent purpose tag embedded in the token payload.

secret.description: Tenant HMAC-SHA256 signing secret (min 16 chars; or omit from body and pass via X-Tinplate-Signing-Secret header, processed in volatile memory only).

subject.description: Opaque subscriber or user identifier (avoid raw email if not needed).

unsubscribe_base_url.description: Optional HTTPS URL to generate RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers.

name: tinplate_consent_tokens
